learning_outcomes.text: Learn the basic principles of mass transfer and use them in problem solving.
Be able to find mass transfer and diffusion coefficients for gases, solids and liquids.
Calculate mass transfer coefficients in laminar and turbulent flows depending on physical conditions.
Perform analogies related to momentum, heat, and mass transfer through dimensional analysis.
Be able to design tray and packed columns where mass transfer occurs.

syllabus_topics: Analogy between momentum, heat and mass transfer
Molecular mass transfer in gases, liquids and solids
Mass transfer in laminar and turbulent flow
Continuous mass transfer processes in two-phase systems
Classification of mass transfer processes and design principles
Molecular transport equations and comparison of momentum, heat, and mass transport
Derivation of equations using molar fluxes for molecular transport and convective flow
Molecular diffusion coefficients for binary gas mixtures
Mass transfer coefficients in laminar and turbulent flow
Determination of interfacial composition and film and overall mass transfer coefficients
bibliography: C.J. Geankoplis,”Mass Transport Phenomena”, Edwards Brothers Inc., Second Edition, 1977.
C.J. Geankoplis, “Transport Processes and Unit Operations”, Allyn and Bacon, Second Edition, 1993.2.
